description: We’re EmberNova, a team from Giza, Egypt, brought together by a question: how can decades of NASA experiments help crews prepare for fires in space? For the Flame in Freefall challenge, we combined AI, web development, and data visualization to build a research workspace that lets users trace findings back to the original experiments. We also built the Learning Laboratory for students and Space Fire Academy for children to explore the same science through experiments and play.
